title: Closing the Loop: Feedback based Learning for Agentic RAG on Azure
description:
Search and retrieval quality is the foundation of effective agentic RAG. This session explores practical ways to improve RAG accuracy using human feedback across Microsoft Foundry and MAF patterns—from relevance rankings, preference signals and error tagging to LLM-as-a-judge, Simulation SDKs, semantic reranking, query refinement, and grounded evaluation. Learn how to turn user interactions into measurable signals that continuously improve retrieval, ranking, and answer quality in production.

Seating for this session is first-come, first-served. Add it to your schedule to plan your day and arrive early to secure a spot.
